Overview

Toledo is a city in OH with a population of 270,871. Glass City with incredibly cheap housing, Great Lakes access, and a manufacturing legacy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
